Found it! The problem is in sourceRunner.ts lines 33-36:

```typescript
start_date: event.date,
start_time: event.time,
end_date: event.date,
end_time: event.time,
```

The Kulturhuset scraper returns:
- `date`: "2026-03-26" (just the date part)
- `time`: "08:30" (just the time part)

When sourceRunner combines them as `start_time: event.time`, it's just storing "08:30" which is interpreted as local time, but when compared with the current timestamp (which includes timezone), the comparison fails.

The fix is to change the Kulturhuset scraper to return the full ISO timestamp, or to fix the sourceRunner to properly combine date and time.
